submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency among all three candidates while meeting all constraints. The validation studies confirm an expected efficiency of 91.862% (±0.657%), representing a 7.748% advantage over the second-best option (Algorithm-L2) and a 19.68% advantage over Algorithm-L3. This configuration also shows a 0.806% improvement over the baseline performance. Algorithm-L1 utilizes learned calibrations which contribute to its superior performance. The 30 GeV threshold lies well within the required 20-60 GeV range, the algorithm is confirmed as deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware, and it operates within the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. Multiple validation runs (including neighboring thresholds at 29 and 31 GeV, and repeat runs at 30 GeV) consistently demonstrate that this configuration delivers the best signal efficiency, fulfilling the primary goal of achieving the highest possible efficiency at the allocated rate.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV achieves 91.862% efficiency (validated average), which is the highest among all candidates tested. This represents a 7.748% advantage over Algorithm-L2 (84.114%) and significantly outperforms Algorithm-L3 (72.93% at 30 GeV).
requirements.evidence_source: Validation results showing efficiency_L1_30GeV=92.806%, validation runs confirming average of 91.862%

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 is one of the three candidate algorithms (L1, L2, L3) identified in the project specifications and evaluated in the analysis.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: All three candidate algorithms, including Algorithm-L1, were confirmed as hardware feasible for Level-1 trigger deployment.
The recommended threshold of 30 GeV falls well within the required range of 20-60 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Operate within the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz
requirements.evidence: The recommended configuration meets the rate constraint as confirmed in the validation analysis.
